mechanism: Minocycline may increase risk of genital mycotic infections and minocycline has potential nephrotoxic effects that could compound SGLT2 inhibitor-associated renal considerations; both agents have documented photosensitivity and rare hepatotoxicity potential.
action: Monitor for signs of genital infections and photosensitivity; counsel on sun protection; monitor renal function and liver enzymes periodically; ensure adequate hydration.
